name: The Veiled City
description: Magic hides in plain sight in a modern metropolis. Wizards, fae, and monsters walk among the unknowing mortals.
seed_prompt: A modern city where magic exists in the shadows. Ancient powers operate behind a veil of normalcy while ordinary people remain blissfully unaware.
lore_content:
The Veiled City exists in the shadows of a modern metropolis, where magic operates behind a curtain of mundane reality. The Covenant of Mages enforces the Laws of Magic from their hidden sanctum, punishing those who use magic to kill, manipulate minds, or breach the barriers between worlds.

Warden Commander Elena Blackwood leads the Covenant's enforcers in the city. A war veteran of the Vampire Courts conflict, she carries a silver blade that can cut through any supernatural defense. Her harsh exterior hides guilt over those she couldn't save during the Crimson Night massacre.

The Fae Courts maintain embassies in the city, disguised as exclusive nightclubs. The Summer Court's 'Solstice' caters to artists and dreamers, while Winter's 'Permafrost' draws the ambitious and ruthless. Crossing either court means owing debts that compound with terrifying interest.

Detective Marcus Chen runs the unofficial 'weird cases' desk at the police department. A Sensitive with limited magical sight, he bridges the gap between mundane law enforcement and the supernatural community. He's learned that justice looks different when your suspect can turn into mist.

The Archivist, a young woman named Sarah who inherited the sum of all recorded magical knowledge, operates from a used bookstore called 'Between the Lines.' She cannot act directly but trades information for favors. Those who break deals with her simply... vanish from records.

Beneath the streets, the Undertown sprawls - a network of tunnels where those unwelcome in both worlds make their home. Goblins run gambling dens, minor spirits sell cheap enchantments, and things that have no names lurk in the deepest passages.

The old vampire bloodlines were destroyed in the war, but something new moves through the nightclubs and blood banks. The Crimson Covenant claims to offer a new way - feeding without killing. The Mages remain skeptical.

Magic has rules. Iron disrupts fairy magic. Thresholds protect homes from uninvited supernatural entry. True names have power. And above all, the Veil must be maintained - because if humanity learned the truth, the resulting panic would be worse than any monster.

origins.name: Sensitive
origins.description: Some individuals are born with a heightened awareness of magic and the supernatural.
traits: Sixth Sense: Gain advantage on saving throws against illusions.
Limited Magic Sight: You can perceive faint magical auras.

origins.name: Covenant Initiate
origins.description: Raised from a young age within the Covenant of Mages, you understand the basics of magical theory and practice.
traits: Magical Aptitude: You know one extra cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list.
Covenant Training: You have advantage on checks made to identify magical objects or rituals.

origins.name: Undertown Dweller
origins.description: Life in the Undertown is hard, but it breeds resourcefulness and a deep understanding of the city's underbelly.
traits: Undertown Contacts: You know how to find information and assistance in the Undertown.
Shadow Walker: You have advantage on Stealth checks made in dim light or darkness.

origins.name: Fae-Touched
origins.description: A chance encounter with the Fae has left you marked by their magic, granting you unusual abilities and a connection to the Courts.
traits: Fae Favor: Choose Summer or Winter. You have advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with members of that court.
Glimmering Presence: Once per long rest, you can cast the 'Friends' cantrip.

origins.name: Crimson-Born
origins.description: A recent initiate of the Crimson Covenant. You walk the path of modern vampirism.
traits: Blood Thirst: You have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when hungry.
Crimson Resilience: You gain resistance to necrotic damage.

archetypes.name: Warden
archetypes.description: An enforcer of the Covenant, tasked with upholding the Laws of Magic and protecting the Veil.

features.name: Veil Guardian
features.description: You gain advantage on saving throws against effects that would reveal the existence of magic to non-sensitives.

features.name: Law Enforcement
features.description: You can use your action to restrain a creature you have grappled.

archetypes.name: Spellbinder
archetypes.description: A versatile mage who uses both arcane knowledge and raw magical power to shape reality.

features.name: Arcane Studies
features.description: Choose a school of magic. Spells of that school cost one less spell slot (minimum of 1).

archetypes.name: Shadow Dealer
archetypes.description: A cunning manipulator who thrives in the shadows, dealing in secrets, favors, and forbidden knowledge.

features.name: Whispers in the Dark
features.description: You gain advantage on Intelligence checks made to gather information in urban environments.

archetypes.name: Channeler
archetypes.description: A conduit for supernatural energies, drawing power from sources beyond the Veil to heal, protect, or destroy.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a Divine Domain appropriate for the setting (e.g., Knowledge, Life, Trickery).

archetypes.name: Bloodhunter
archetypes.description: A disciplined warrior dedicated to hunting down creatures of the night, often at a great personal cost.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose one type of aberration, fiend, or undead. You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track them and Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

setting_skills.name: Streetwise
setting_skills.description: Understanding the unspoken rules and power dynamics of the urban landscape.

setting_skills.name: Arcane Lore
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of magical theories, spells, and rituals.

setting_skills.name: Veiled History
setting_skills.description: Understanding the hidden history of the Veiled City and its supernatural inhabitants.
